{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Experiential aspects/dimensions of Yelp restaurant reviews (the review 'aspects' being discussed), organized around food and service experience",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "food_quality_rating", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures the food-experience aspect and its sentiment valence, a core review dimension."},
    {"name": "food_item_highlight", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Adds granularity within the food aspect (specific dishes praised/criticized), a coherent facet."},
    {"name": "service_quality_rating", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures the service-experience aspect and valence, parallel to food_quality."},
    {"name": "service_issue_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Decomposes service problems into actionable subtypes, deepening the service facet."},
    {"name": "staff_behavior_tone", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures staff interpersonal tone, a distinct aspect of the service/staff experience."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.85,
  "structure_quality": 0.8,
  "focus_actionability": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The columns collectively centre on a single coherent, data-inferable focus: the experiential aspects of restaurant reviews. They cluster tightly around two well-formed dimensions -- food (quality valence + specific-item highlight) and service (quality valence + issue type + staff tone) -- rather than being a scattered grab-bag, and none are mechanical (no token counts or bare sentiment on the whole review). Structure is sound: each aspect has both a valence facet and a finer categorical facet, giving useful granularity beyond a single restatement, though there is mild overlap between service_issue_type and staff_behavior_tone (rude appears in both), and other plausible aspects (ambiance, price, wait time, cleanliness) are absent, slightly narrowing coverage of 'aspects of their experience.' The implied focus is clearly actionable -- an analyst could quantify which experiential dimensions dominate reviews and drill into specific failure modes. Deductions are for the narrow aspect coverage and the partial redundancy between the two service categoricals."
